intent: User approved A02-v2 layout; this variation changes only the visual treatment to match the current survivor HUD.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, precise visual restyling of an approved game UI.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the approved A02 rank-roadmap layout. Image 2 is the current game HUD STYLE REFERENCE; copy its visual language, not its layout. Image 3 is a close-up of the current HUD's ability-card construction; copy these precise corner cuts, thin outline, inset hairline, isolated corner marks and flat material treatment.
The user says the layout is perfect. Preserve Image 1's composition and information EXACTLY: full three-row roadmap, same six columns (five ranks and capstone), left illustrated ability panels, header and portrait, bottom illustrated capstone preview, one upgrade button, same state and wording, visible battlefield margin, no scroll. This is purely an aesthetic variant matched to the live test-range HUD.

ART DIRECTION — specific shape/design changes, not a yellow recolor:
- Replace the deep navy/blue gradient machinery with near-black charcoal and graphite translucent surfaces, approximately #0e1316. Match the quiet dark glass of Image 2, with subtle panel-local shadows and an almost invisible top wash.
- Replace thick glowing cyan outer frames, bevel stacks and hexagonal sockets with the actual current HUD's precise geometry: compact square-like or slightly rectangular cards with a small 45-degree clipped TOP LEFT corner and clipped BOTTOM RIGHT corner; thin continuous off-white perimeter; very fine inset contour; short isolated ivory corner marks. Keep the same node centres, icon sizes, labels and spacing as Image 1. These are elegant framed ability tiles, not generic web cards. No hexagon borders anywhere. The portrait also becomes a cropped rectangular panel with one clipped corner, matching the HUD portrait.
- Use off-white #eef0e8, soft gray #c3c8c2 and white for frame strokes, text and icons. Very slim pale rails connect the cards. Row dividers are single low-contrast hairlines, not full neon boxes. Remove header's broad angular sci-fi wings and huge PAUSED plaque; keep the same header region and title/portrait positions but use a clean rule and a modest PAUSED label.
- Preserve the hierarchy and illustrative richness: retain the rifle art, missile turret art, cool blue Burst artwork, and cinematic Snow White rifle illustration in the preview. Their natural image colors are welcome; do not desaturate the illustrations into gray. The theme match is in the UI chrome and geometry. Preserve Snow White's identity.
- Typography closely resembles Rajdhani: crisp condensed humanist squared sans-serif, strong uppercase headings, small spaced overlines, generous readable body text. Keep clean baselines and all names fully readable.
- YELLOW IS NOT THE THEME. Gold/amber is only a tiny status accent (a small SP chip, one short selection tick, and tiny capstone corner slashes). All rank costs remain ivory. No gold-filled nodes, no gold rows, no bright yellow border enclosing the whole menu, no golden haze, no cyan UI neon, no massive glowing button.
- OWNED nodes: softly filled charcoal tile, white icon, tiny pale mint check at the lower corner. NEXT-PURCHASABLE nodes: brighter ivory perimeter, no check. LOCKED nodes: low-contrast gray frame and subdued glyph, still readable text.
- CAPSTONES: dignified clipped rectangular tiles, perhaps an extra fine inset rule and a tiny amber slash like the current HUD Burst card's corner accent. Preserve each capstone's distinctive icon but remove ornamental crowns floating outside the cards. These should feel important through crisp construction and hierarchy. They are ALL LOCKED: no checkmarks. Selected Unyielding uses an ivory selected frame with one small amber corner tick, not a gold glow.
- The single UPGRADE WEAPON action becomes a flat graphite button, thin ivory clipped-corner outline, white condensed label, a short amber indicator at one edge. It must look native to the current HUD's controls. Show its 4 SP cost clearly.
- Key tabs use compact dark physical-key shapes with ivory rims like the current HUD. Keep TAB RESUME at bottom right.
- Keep most of the screen occupied, with dim battlefield visible on every side. No replacement full-screen web page, no scroll, no popups.

Exact information and state must remain unchanged:
Header "ABILITY RANKS"; "SNOW WHITE | LV 14 | 4 SP"; "PAUSED".
Six columns: "RANK 1 / BASE", "RANK 2 / 1 SP", "RANK 3 / 2 SP", "RANK 4 / 3 SP", "RANK 5 / 4 SP", "CAPSTONE / AUTO · FREE".
WEAPON nodes: "Seven Dwarves", "Marked Rounds", "Afterburn", "Burning + Slow", "Charging", "Unyielding". First FOUR owned and checked; Charging next available; Unyielding selected for preview but still LOCKED.
SPECIAL: "Auto-Turret", "Expanded Arsenal", "Defensive Line", "Incendiary Arsenal", "Permanent Emplacement", "Detonation". First THREE owned and checked; Incendiary Arsenal available; rest locked.
BURST: "Seven Dwarves", "Fully Active", "Focused Fire", "Pierce + Stun", "A Century of Prep Time", "A Goddess Who Cannot Yield". Only FIRST owned and checked; Fully Active available; rest locked.
Each capstone label includes "AT RANK 5". Wrap long labels neatly.
Bottom preview exact text: "WEAPON · CAPSTONE"; "UNYIELDING"; "Bullet kills: 20% chance to restore 1 HP."; "Unlocks automatically at Weapon Rank 5."
Action exact text: "UPGRADE WEAPON · 4 SP"; small subline "Rank 4 → 5: Charging + Unyielding".
Footer: "Earn SP by leveling up. Spend on any ability. Capstones unlock at Rank 5." and "TAB RESUME".
No invented mechanics, new unlock gates, missing nodes, changed costs or accidental duplicate columns.
Output aspect ratio: keep Image 1's exact ultrawide 21:9 framing. Keep the approved layout; change its UI skin as instructed.
